title: The MacNeil House (The Exorcist 1973)
description: The Georgetown corner house where Regan's bedroom window looked out over the drop; a fake wing was built onto it so the fall would land on the steps. Private residence.

title: The Tombs (The Exorcist 1973)
description: The Georgetown pub where Father Karras drinks and wrestles with his faith, and it shows up again in Exorcist III. Still open, still pouring.

title: Georgetown University (The Exorcist 1973)
description: Healy Hall and Dahlgren Chapel play themselves, and the chapel is where the statue of the Virgin turns up desecrated. The campus doubled as itself again for Exorcist III.

title: Martin's Tavern (The Exorcist 1973)
description: The Wisconsin Avenue bar where Karras and Father Dyer drink together, a 1933 Georgetown institution that has barely changed.

title: Holy Trinity Church (The Exorcist III 1990)
description: The Georgetown parish where the Gemini Killer stages his church desecration. The oldest Catholic church in DC and still active, so visit respectfully.

title: Washington Canoe Club (The Exorcist III 1990)
description: The Potomac riverbank below Key Bridge where Kinderman finds the body of altar boy Thomas Kintry. The wooden boathouse is still on the water.

title: Lt. Kinderman's House (The Exorcist III 1990)
description: The Foxhall Village home where Kinderman's family dinner and the carp-in-the-bathtub business play out. Private residence, admire from the sidewalk.

title: The Dakota (Rosemary's Baby 1968)
description: The Gothic pile on Central Park West that played the Bramford, where Rosemary moves in next to the Castevets. Residents live here, so view it from the 72nd Street corner.

title: Evans City Cemetery (Night of the Living Dead 1968)
description: They're coming to get you, Barbra. The hilltop graveyard where the first zombie shambles out of the trees. The chapel was saved by a horror-fan fundraiser.

title: The Farmhouse Site (Night of the Living Dead 1968)
description: The country road where the besieged farmhouse stood before it was torn down; a cabin sits on the spot now. Private land, keep to the roadside.
address: 260 Ash Stop Road, Evans City, PA 16033

title: Pittsburgh-Monroeville Airport (Dawn of the Dead 1978)
description: The little airfield two miles from the mall where Stephen and Fran lift the helicopter off with the dead closing in. Romero came back to build Jordy Verrill's farmhouse for Creepshow.

title: Wampum Mine (Day of the Dead 1985)
description: The limestone mine turned document vault that became the underground bunker where Dr. Logan trained Bub. Working private property today.

title: Potter School (The Birds 1963)
description: The Bodega schoolhouse where Melanie sits smoking while the crows silently pile up on the jungle gym behind her. Private property, best seen from Bodega Lane.

title: St. Teresa of Avila Church (The Birds 1963)
description: The 1860 white clapboard church standing just in front of the schoolhouse in Hitchcock's shots. Hitchcock went to Mass here during the shoot.

title: The Tides Wharf (The Birds 1963)
description: The dockside restaurant where the townspeople argue about the attacks and the gas station goes up outside. The owner made Hitchcock name the town Bodega Bay before he would allow filming.

title: Joseph Sylvia State Beach (Jaws 1975)
description: Amity Beach itself, where the Kintner boy paddles out on his yellow raft and the crowd stampedes out of the water. The shoreline sat much closer to the road in 1974.

title: The Jaws Bridge (Jaws 1975)
description: Officially the American Legion Memorial Bridge, this is where the shark slips into the estuary while Michael Brody is in the water. Locals still jump off it all summer.

title: Edgartown Town Center (Jaws 1975)
description: The Main and Water Street corner that played downtown Amity, where Brody buys supplies to make the beach-closed signs. The storefronts look almost untouched.
address: Main Street at Water Street, Edgartown, MA 02539

title: Quint's Shack, Menemsha (Jaws 1975)
description: The working fishing harbor where Quint's shark-jawed shack stood and the Orca tied up. The building at the inlet is the Menemsha Galley now.

title: The Amityville House Stand-In (The Amityville Horror 1979)
description: The DeFeo family refused access to the real Ocean Avenue house, so this Toms River riverside home got the famous quarter-round eye windows bolted on instead. Private residence.

title: Oakwood Manor (The Amityville Horror 2005)
description: The 1880 Queen Anne on Silver Lake that stood in for 112 Ocean Avenue in the Ryan Reynolds remake, with a facade added for the eye windows and stripped off afterward. Private residence.

title: The Village Pub, Antioch (The Amityville Horror 2005)
description: The northern Illinois bar used in the 2005 remake, a short drive from the Silver Lake house. It trades as The Lodge of Antioch today.

title: Pyrford Court (The Omen 1976)
description: The Surrey manor that played Pershore Hall, including the birthday party where Damien's nanny hangs herself off the roof shouting it's all for you, Damien. Private estate.
address: Pyrford Common Road, Woking, Surrey GU22 8RU, UK

title: All Saints Church, Fulham (The Omen 1976)
description: The riverside church where the lightning rod comes loose and impales Father Brennan on the path below. It sits right at the north end of Putney Bridge.
address: Pryors Bank, Putney Bridge Approach, Fulham, London SW6 3LA, UK

title: Guildford Cathedral (The Omen 1976)
description: The modernist brick cathedral on Stag Hill used for the wedding sequence where Damien first loses his mind at the sight of a church. Open to visitors.
address: Stag Hill, Guildford, Surrey GU2 7UP, UK

title: Brookwood Cemetery (The Omen 1976)
description: The American Military Cemetery section of Britain's largest graveyard, standing in for the grim burial ground where Thorn and Jennings dig up a jackal. Open to the public.
address: Cemetery Pales, Brookwood, Woking, Surrey GU24 0BL, UK

title: Saltair (Carnival of Souls 1962)
description: The derelict pavilion on the Great Salt Lake that became the dance hall full of ghouls calling Mary Henry home. The version in the film burned down; the current venue sits about a mile away.

title: The Evil Dead Cabin Site (The Evil Dead 1981)
description: The Tennessee backwoods road where Sam Raimi's cabin stood until it burned in 1982, leaving bits of chimney and foundation. Private land, do not go hunting for souvenirs.

title: Maitland Hardware, East Corinth (Beetlejuice 1988)
description: The village general store dressed as Maitland Hardware, where Adam buys the model-town supplies in the opening minutes. Still a working store in the middle of Winter River.

title: The Maitland House Hill (Beetlejuice 1988)
description: The hilltop off Jewell Lane where the Maitland house was built as a facade and torn down after the shoot. The view of the valley is exactly the one Tim Burton framed.

title: Pogonip Clubhouse (The Lost Boys 1987)
description: The 1921 hilltop lodge above Santa Cruz used for the exterior of Grandpa's house, the one with the stuffed animals and the root beer. Park and walk the trail to it.
address: 333 Golf Club Drive, Santa Cruz, CA 95060

title: Atlantis Fantasyworld (The Lost Boys 1987)
description: The real Santa Cruz comic shop where the Frog brothers hand Sam his vampire-hunting education. It has since moved to Cedar Street, still open and still selling comics.

title: Verdugo Hills High School (The Craft 1996)
description: The Tujunga campus that played St. Benedict's Academy, where Sarah meets Nancy, Bonnie and Rochelle and the four of them make it a coven. Working school, view from the street.

title: El Adobe Market (The Craft 1996)
description: The Hollywood Boulevard storefront used as the occult shop where the girls buy their supplies and Lirio warns them about invoking the spirit.

title: Medea Creek Park (Poltergeist 1982)
description: The Agoura Hills park whose hillside gave Spielberg the opening shot looking down over the tidy suburban streets of Cuesta Verde. Free public park, easy to walk.
address: Medea Creek Park, Agoura Hills, CA 91301

title: The Perron Farmhouse (The Conjuring 2013)
description: Every exterior of the Perron family farmhouse, including the bird-slamming and cellar-door scares, was shot at this house on the Black River, not in Rhode Island. Private residence, admire from the road.

title: The Warren House and Occult Museum (The Conjuring 2013)
description: Ed and Lorraine's home, the one with the locked room full of cursed objects and the Annabelle case, is this Forest Hills house in Wilmington. Private residence.

title: Father Gordon's Church (The Conjuring 2013)
description: First Baptist Church stands in for the parish where the Warrens beg for an exorcism approval that never arrives in time. Still an active downtown church.

title: UNC Wilmington, DePaolo Hall (The Conjuring 2013)
description: The lecture-hall scenes where the Warrens present their case files to a packed room of students.

title: 33 Graeme Road, Enfield (The Conjuring 2 2016)
description: The Hodgson house exterior, where Janet gets dragged around by a poltergeist, is this ordinary Enfield terrace. Production repaved the whole street afterwards. Private home.
address: 33 Graeme Rd, Enfield EN1 3UU, United Kingdom

title: Parrott-Camp-Soucy House (The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It 2021)
description: This 1842 Second Empire Victorian played the sinister house at the heart of the Arne Johnson case. Private residence.

title: Coweta County Courthouse (The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It 2021)
description: The courtroom where Arne Johnson pleads not guilty by reason of demonic possession, the first US case to try it. Interior and exterior are the real Newnan courthouse.

title: Starr's Mill (The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It 2021)
description: The red mill house beside the waterfall that shows up in the Georgia stretch of the Warrens' investigation. A photogenic public spot on Whitewater Creek.

title: Mia and John's House (Annabelle 2014)
description: The couple's first house, where cult members break in next door and the doll's reign of terror begins. Private residence on a quiet Windsor Square block.
address: 228 N Gramercy Pl, Los Angeles, CA 90004

title: The Langham Apartments (Annabelle 2014)
description: This 1920s Koreatown building played the Palmeri Apartments, home of the sewing-machine elevator scare and that endless basement corridor chase.
address: 715 S Normandie Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90005

title: Wilshire United Methodist Church (Annabelle 2014)
description: The church where Father Perez tries to carry Annabelle inside and gets blasted backwards down the steps by whatever is riding the doll.

title: Big Sky Movie Ranch (Annabelle: Creation 2017)
description: The Mullins doll-maker farmhouse exterior, with its stair lift and scarecrow, was built out here in Simi Valley. Working private ranch, not open to walk-ins.

title: Anna's House (The Curse of La Llorona 2019)
description: The 1906 Harvard Heights home whose front porch and windows the Weeping Woman stalks throughout the film. Private residence, view from the sidewalk.
address: 1649 S Hobart Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90006

title: 1st Street Bridge, LA River (The Curse of La Llorona 2019)
description: The concrete channel where La Llorona's drowning legend plays out, looking south toward the 4th and 6th Street bridges. Classic LA River horror geography.
address: 1st St Bridge over LA River, Los Angeles, CA 90012

title: Corvin Castle (The Nun 2018)
description: The exterior and courtyard of the Abbey of St Carta is this 15th-century Transylvanian fortress. Production built a new access point just for the shoot. Open to visitors.

title: Bethlen Castle, Cris (The Nun 2018)
description: The abbey lodgings and the icehouse where Sister Irene and Father Burke find the dead nun. A crumbling Renaissance castle with a graveyard built for the film.
address: Str. Castelul Bethlen 187, Cris, Danes, Mures 547201, Romania

title: Mogosoaia Palace (The Nun 2018)
description: The Brancovenesc-style palace outside Bucharest doubled as St Vincent's girls' school in London. Public grounds and a lakeside park you can walk.

title: Palace of the Parliament (The Nun 2018)
description: Ceausescu's colossal Bucharest palace stands in for the Vatican corridors where Father Burke gets his assignment. Guided tours run daily.

title: Couvent des Precheurs (The Nun II 2023)
description: The former Aix monastery, converted to a school in 1836, plays the boarding school where Valak hunts Sister Irene through cloisters and hallways.

title: Chapelle de la Visitation (The Nun II 2023)
description: Rue Mignet's chapel provided the Tarascon church exteriors, including the opening where the priest burns alive on the steps.

title: The Lambert House (Insidious 2010)
description: The 1910 Craftsman on an oval street where Dalton falls into his coma and the Further first opens up. Private residence on a quiet Victoria Park loop.
address: 4350 Victoria Park Dr, Los Angeles, CA 90019

title: The Lamberts' Second House (Insidious 2010)
description: The 1927 Carthay Circle home the family flees to, only to learn the haunting was never about the house. Private residence.
address: 1153 S Point View St, Los Angeles, CA 90035

title: Herald Examiner Building (Insidious 2010)
description: Hearst's abandoned 1914 newspaper palace downtown became the Further, the black astral corridors where the Lipstick-Face Demon waits.

title: The Smith Estate (Insidious: Chapter 2 2013)
description: The hilltop Queen Anne mansion in Highland Park serves as the film's central haunted house. Private property, best seen from El Mio Drive below.
address: 5905 El Mio Dr, Los Angeles, CA 90042

title: Elise Rainier's House (Insidious: Chapter 2 and 3)
description: Elise's own home, the one Quinn comes knocking at in Chapter 3 begging her to contact the dead. Private residence in Highland Park.

title: Linda Vista Hospital (Insidious: Chapter 2 2013)
description: The derelict Boyle Heights hospital where Josh and Carl track down Parker Crane's past. One of the most-filmed haunted buildings in LA, now senior housing.
address: 610 S St Louis St, Los Angeles, CA 90023

title: Fleur de Lis Apartments (Insidious: Chapter 3 2015)
description: The 1928 Chateauesque Hollywood building where Quinn is bedridden and the Man Who Can't Breathe stalks the floor above her.

title: Tilghman House, Drew University (Insidious: The Red Door 2023)
description: The 1894 Tudor academic building on Drew's campus plays the fraternity house where Dalton's repressed memories start clawing back.

title: Madison's House (Malignant 2021)
description: The tall dark Pasadena house where Gabriel takes over and bodies start piling up. Set in Seattle, shot entirely in LA. Private residence.

title: Lacy Street Production Center (Saw 2004)
description: James Wan shot all of Saw in 18 days inside this one converted warehouse: the filthy bathroom, the hospital, the cop station, the garage, all the same building.

title: Blairstown Diner (Friday the 13th 1980)
description: The diner where Steve Christy kills time over coffee and pie while his counselors are being butchered back at camp. Still open, still serving, and still throwing a party every Friday the 13th.

title: Roy's Hall / Blairstown Theatre (Friday the 13th 1980)
description: Annie strolls past this 1913 movie house on her doomed walk through town in the opening act. Painted red in 1979, bright blue today, facade unmistakable.

title: Blair Creek Bridge (Friday the 13th 1980)
description: The bridge Annie crosses heading west out of town, asking anyone who'll listen how to get to Camp Crystal Lake. The stone arches look almost untouched since 1979.
address: Bridge Street at Main Street, Blairstown, NJ 07825

title: Hope General Store (Friday the 13th 1980)
description: The old general store where Annie asks for directions to Camp Crystal Lake and gets the look everybody gives her. It has traded as an antiques shop in recent years.

title: Moravian Cemetery (Friday the 13th 1980)
description: The black iron cemetery arch where Enos drops Annie off to hitch the rest of the way. The burial ground dates to the 1760s and the gate is still there.

title: Crazy Ralph's Corner (Friday the 13th 1980)
description: The corner where Crazy Ralph rolls up on his bicycle to tell Annie she's going to a death curse. Fan pilgrimage stop number one in Hope.
address: Walnut Street at High Street, Hope, NJ 07844

title: Millbrook Road Camp Run (Friday the 13th 1980)
description: The rural stretch where Jack, Marcie and Ned barrel toward Camp Crystal Lake in the pickup. Private property lines both sides, shoot it from the road.

title: Alice's Apartment Interior (Friday the 13th Part 2 1981)
description: The building whose interiors became Alice's apartment, where Jason collects her head in the Part 2 prologue. Now a behavioral health center, admire from the sidewalk.

title: Jeff's Truck Tow Spot (Friday the 13th Part 2 1981)
description: Where Jeff and Sandra's truck gets hooked and hauled off in New Preston, stranding them right where you'd least want to be stranded.
address: 9 East Shore Road, New Preston, CT 06777

title: Church Street, New Preston (Friday the 13th Part 2 1981)
description: The village corner where Ted greets Jeff and Sandra as they roll into town. The New Preston streetscape is remarkably unchanged from 1981.

title: Packanack Lodge Counselor Training Center (Friday the 13th Part 2 1981)
description: The counselor training center where Paul, Ginny and the rest camp out next door to Crystal Lake. The film's buildings were demolished in 2009, so this is a ghost stop.

title: North Spectacle Pond (Friday the 13th Part 2 1981)
description: Connecticut's stand-in for Crystal Lake, the water Jeff and Sandra hike past on their way to the forbidden camp. The shoreline still reads exactly like the film.

title: Harold and Edna's Store (Friday the 13th Part III 1982)
description: The Bouquet Canyon roadside store where Jason opens Part III by putting a cleaver in Harold and a knitting needle in Edna. The 3D kill that started the whole movie.
address: 34813 Bouquet Canyon Road, Santa Clarita, CA 91390

title: Spunky Canyon Store (Friday the 13th Part III 1982)
description: The country store where Shelly and Vera run into the biker gang, setting up one of Part III's best set pieces. It still operates as a small market and smokehouse.
address: 15488 Spunky Canyon Road, Santa Clarita, CA 91390

title: Vera's House at Heritage Junction (Friday the 13th Part III 1982)
description: The 1878 Victorian used as Vera's family home. It stood on Walnut Street during filming and was moved to Heritage Junction in 1987, where you can walk right up to it.

title: The Jarvis House (Friday the 13th: The Final Chapter 1984)
description: Tommy Jarvis's house, where a machete-swinging Corey Feldman finally puts Jason down. Private property known as Blackberry Creek Farm, view from Topanga Canyon Blvd only.
address: 1801 N Topanga Canyon Blvd, Topanga, CA 90290

title: Zaca Lake (Friday the 13th: The Final Chapter 1984)
description: The secluded lake used for the skinny dipping sequence. It sits on private retreat land off Foxen Canyon Road in the Santa Barbara backcountry.
address: 8000 Foxen Canyon Road, Santa Maria, CA 93454

title: Forest Green Sheriff's Department (Friday the 13th Part VI 1986)
description: The building that played Sheriff Garris's station in Jason Lives, where Tommy Jarvis begs a town that renamed itself to believe him. Covington's old jail still stands.

title: Eternal Peace Cemetery (Friday the 13th Part VI 1986)
description: The graveyard where Tommy digs Jason up and a lightning bolt through a fence post brings him back. Arguably the most important resurrection in the franchise.
address: Academy Street at West Central Avenue, Madison, GA 30650

title: Camp Forest Green at Hard Labor Creek (Friday the 13th Part VI 1986)
description: Camp Daniel Morgan inside Hard Labor Creek State Park, the Georgia camp that became Camp Forest Green. The first film in the series where the kids actually show up at camp.
address: 5 Hard Labor Creek Road, Rutledge, GA 30663

title: Karloff's General Merchandise Corner (Friday the 13th Part VI 1986)
description: The rural crossroads outside Covington where the Jason Lives general store stood, a sly Boris Karloff nod on the sign. Country backroad, nothing but fields now.
address: Old Starrsville Road at 2nd Avenue, Covington, GA 30014

title: Byrnes Lake (Friday the 13th Part VII 1988)
description: The Baldwin County lake that played Crystal Lake for The New Blood, where telekinetic Tina goes head to head with Jason. The houses were shells built for the shoot.
address: Byrnes Lake Road, Bay Minette, AL 36507

title: The Voorhees House (Jason Goes to Hell 1993)
description: The derelict Voorhees family home where the Final Friday climax plays out and Jason is finally dragged down to hell. A private residence, keep to the sidewalk.
address: 24035 Eagle Mountain Street, Canoga Park, CA 91304

title: Joey B's Diner (Jason Goes to Hell 1993)
description: The roadside diner where Jason's body-hopping spree turns a quiet lunch counter into a bloodbath. The building has cycled through several restaurants since.
address: 299 East Thousand Oaks Blvd, Thousand Oaks, CA 91360

title: Buntzen Lake North Beach (Freddy vs. Jason 2003)
description: The BC lake that played Camp Crystal Lake for the cornfield-and-lakeside showdown. The cabins were built for the shoot and torn out afterward, but the beach is public.
address: North end of BC Hydro Service Road, Anmore, BC

title: The Outpost Gas Station (Friday the 13th 2009)
description: The country store and gas station that played the Outpost in the 2009 remake, the last stop before the kids head into Jason's woods. Real working store southwest of Austin.

title: Camp Crystal Lake, Bastrop (Friday the 13th 2009)
description: The Bastrop County property that became Camp Crystal Lake for the 2009 remake, including the burned-out cabins from the opening. Private land, a drive-by only.

title: Trent's Lake House (Friday the 13th 2009)
description: The Wimberley house that played Trent's family lake retreat, where most of the remake's body count racks up. Private residence, admire from the road.

title: The Barn (Friday the 13th 2009)
description: The Round Rock barn where Clay and Whitney find Jason's underground lair and the remake hurtles into its finale. Private property on Harrell Parkway.

title: Vasquez Rocks (Dracula 1931)
description: Those tilted sandstone slabs stood in for the Borgo Pass as Renfield's coach rattles toward Castle Dracula. Universal shot Bela Lugosi's Transylvania an hour north of Hollywood.
address: 10700 W Escondido Canyon Rd, Agua Dulce, CA 91390

title: Wakulla Springs (Creature from the Black Lagoon 1954)
description: Every underwater shot of the Gill-man gliding beneath Julie Adams was filmed in this spring-fed Florida basin. The water is still that impossible clear blue, and you can swim it.
address: 465 Wakulla Park Dr, Wakulla Springs, FL 32327

title: Bray Film Studios (Hammer Horror)
description: Down Place on the Thames, the riverside country house that became Hammer's factory. Curse of Frankenstein, Dracula and most of the classics were shot inside and against these whitewashed walls.
address: Down Place, Windsor Road, Water Oakley, Windsor SL4 5UG, UK

title: Oakley Court (The Brides of Dracula 1960)
description: The Gothic Revival pile next door to Bray that Hammer pointed a camera at whenever they needed a cursed chateau. Curse of Frankenstein, Brides of Dracula, Plague of the Zombies. Now a hotel.
address: Windsor Road, Water Oakley, Windsor SL4 5UR, UK

title: Black Park (Hammer Horror)
description: Hammer's all-purpose Transylvania. The misty lake and dense pines doubled for Continental forest in Brides of Dracula and dozens more, a mile from Pinewood and free to walk.
address: Black Park Road, Wexham, Slough SL3 6DR, UK

title: Hampden House (Hammer House of Horror 1980)
description: The Buckinghamshire manor that served as Hammer's headquarters during the TV series and stars in its own opening titles. Gothicised in the 1750s, and it looks it.
address: Hampden Road, Great Hampden, Buckinghamshire HP16 9RD, UK

title: Wykehurst Place (The Legend of Hell House)
description: A French-chateau fantasy dropped into Sussex in 1872, and a go-to haunted house for British horror since the sixties. Private, but visible from the road.
address: Bolney, Haywards Heath, West Sussex RH17 5PD, UK

title: Orava Castle (Nosferatu 1922)
description: Count Orlok's castle, full stop. Murnau shot the gateways, wards and courtyards of this cliff-top Slovak fortress in 1922 and it has been the face of screen vampirism ever since.

title: Starhrad Castle (Nosferatu 1922)
description: The ruin above the Vah where Murnau staged Ellen's final sacrifice, the dawn that destroys Orlok. A steep hike up from the river and worth every step.

title: Wassertor, Wismar (Nosferatu 1922)
description: The last surviving medieval water gate of Wismar, and the arch Orlok carries his own coffin through on his way to a new house in Wisborg. Unchanged since 1922.

title: Salzspeicher, Lubeck (Nosferatu 1922)
description: The 16th-century salt warehouses on the Trave that Murnau cast as Orlok's plague-ridden Wisborg house. The most photographed brick gables in horror.

title: Rotes Kliff, Sylt (Nosferatu 1922)
description: The red cliffs of Kampen, where Greta Schroder's Ellen stands among the dunes staring out to sea, waiting for Hutter. Murnau's loneliest shot.

title: Pernstejn Castle (Nosferatu 2024)
description: The gatehouse and courtyard Thomas Hutter walks into. A nice bit of vampire history: Herzog shot his 1979 Nosferatu here too, with Klaus Kinski.

title: Invalidovna, Prague (Nosferatu 2024)
description: This crumbling 1730s military hospital in Karlin played the cells and corridors of Dr. Sievers' sanatorium, plus the crypt where Orlok sleeps. It opens for tours.

title: Prachov Rocks (Nosferatu 2024)
description: The towering sandstone spires Hutter's coach threads through on the road to Orlok's castle. Bohemian Paradise doing an outstanding impression of the Carpathians.

title: Saint Sophia Greek Orthodox Cathedral (Bram Stoker's Dracula 1992)
description: The gold-drenched Byzantine interior used for Coppola's chapel material. One of the very few real places in an otherwise entirely stage-built Dracula.
address: 1324 S Normandie Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90006

title: Oak Alley Plantation (Interview with the Vampire 1994)
description: Louis' Pointe du Lac estate, with that quarter-mile tunnel of 300-year-old live oaks Brad Pitt and Tom Cruise stalk beneath. Open to visitors daily.

title: Destrehan Plantation (Interview with the Vampire 1994)
description: The 1787 house on River Road that supplied the plantation interiors, including where Lestat turns Louis. Oldest documented plantation home left in the lower Mississippi Valley.

title: Palais Garnier (Interview with the Vampire 1994)
description: The grand staircase and gilded lobby standing in for the Parisian hotel where Louis and Claudia arrive in Europe. Vampires deserve this much marble.

title: Phoenix Cinema, East Finchley (Interview with the Vampire 1994)
description: The auditorium used for the scene where Louis watches a sunrise on screen for the first time in centuries. Still a working cinema, and one of Britain's oldest.
address: 52 High Road, East Finchley, London N2 9PJ, UK

title: Hambleden Estate (Sleepy Hollow 1999)
description: Burton built the entire village of Sleepy Hollow from scratch in Lime Tree Valley on this Buckinghamshire estate, then shot there for a month. The set is long gone, the valley is not.

title: Casa Loma (Crimson Peak 2015)
description: Del Toro used the library of Toronto's Gothic Revival castle for the ballroom sequence where Edith first waltzes with Thomas Sharpe.

title: Dundurn Castle (Crimson Peak 2015)
description: The gardens of this 1835 Hamilton mansion host the Victorian picnic scene. Production also buried a block of Queen Street South in topsoil to fake 1901 Buffalo.

title: Palacio de los Hornillos (The Others 2001)
description: The fog-bound mansion where Nicole Kidman's Grace keeps the curtains drawn. Amenabar shot the exteriors at this 1904 Cantabrian palace built for the Duke of Santo Mauro.
address: Las Fraguas, Arenas de Iguna, 39409 Cantabria, Spain

title: Pontusbadet, Lulea (Let the Right One In 2008)
description: The pool where Oskar holds his breath and the world above the water goes very quiet, very red. Alfredson shot far north of the film's Blackeberg setting for guaranteed snow.

title: Haus zum Walfisch, Freiburg (Suspiria 1977)
description: The blood-red Gothic facade Suzy arrives at in the rain, the Tanz Akademie. Argento used the real Freiburg landmark for the exterior and built the screaming interiors in Rome.

title: Konigsplatz, Munich (Suspiria 1977)
description: The vast empty neoclassical square where blind pianist Daniel walks his dog and Goblin's score turns the night inside out. One of the great horror set pieces, in a real place.

title: BMW Tower, Munich (Suspiria 1977)
description: The four-cylinder skyscraper Argento used as the convention centre where Suzy meets Dr. Mandel and gets the lecture on witches. Brutalism against all that Gothic dread.

title: Grand Hotel Campo dei Fiori (Suspiria 2018)
description: Guadagnino turned this abandoned Art Nouveau hotel above Varese into the Markos Tanz Company, using the derelict 1912 building as his de facto studio. Closed since 1968 and it shows.

title: Burrow Head (The Wicker Man 1973)
description: The clifftop where the wicker man burns and Sergeant Howie screams. Two charred stumps of the second effigy stood in this field for decades. Bring a coat.
address: Burrow Head, Isle of Whithorn, Newton Stewart DG8 8JB, Scotland

title: Anwoth Old Kirk (The Wicker Man 1973)
description: The deconsecrated ruin and graveyard where Howie finds Rowan's grave with a hare in the coffin, plus the maypole dance nearby. Still roofless, still unsettling.
address: Anwoth, Gatehouse of Fleet, Castle Douglas DG7 2EF, Scotland

title: Culzean Castle (The Wicker Man 1973)
description: Christopher Lee's Lord Summerisle lives here, at least on the outside. Robert Adam's clifftop castle on the Ayrshire coast, now National Trust for Scotland.

title: St Ninian's Cave (The Wicker Man 1973)
description: The sea cave where Howie finally finds Rowan, right before he understands the trap. A genuine early Christian pilgrimage site, reached on foot down a wooded glen.
address: Physgill Glen, Whithorn, Newton Stewart DG8 8LL, Scotland

title: Plockton Harbour (The Wicker Man 1973)
description: Howie's seaplane taxis in to Summerisle right here on Loch Carron, then he walks the seafront asking about a missing girl. Filmed over four days in 1972 and barely changed.

title: Ellangowan Hotel, Creetown (The Wicker Man 1973)
description: The interior of the Green Man Inn, where Britt Ekland's Willow sings and the locals close ranks on Sergeant Howie. Still a hotel on Creetown's St John Street.
address: St John Street, Creetown, Newton Stewart DG8 7JF, Scotland

title: Original Myers House Lot (Halloween 1978)
description: The patch of ground where the Myers house actually sat when Carpenter shot the 1978 opening. The house was hauled away in 1987 and an apartment complex now fills the lot. Private residence, admire from the sidewalk.

title: Nichols Hardware Store (Halloween 1978)
description: The storefront Michael robs for rope, a knife and a Halloween mask before he starts hunting Laurie. It sits directly across Mission Street from where the Myers house was relocated.

title: The Wallace House (Halloween 1978)
description: The house across the street where Annie, Bob and Lynda all die, including Bob pinned to the kitchen wall in the original's most famous kill. Private residence, admire from the sidewalk.
address: 1537 North Orange Grove Avenue, Los Angeles, CA 90046

title: Laurie Strode's House (Halloween 1978)
description: Laurie's home in the 1978 original, with the corner porch where she sits holding a pumpkin watching the trick-or-treaters. Private residence, admire from the sidewalk.

title: South Pasadena High School (Halloween 1978)
description: Haddonfield High in the 1978 original. The campus Laurie walks out of while Michael's stolen station wagon idles at the curb.

title: Sierra Madre Pioneer Cemetery (Halloween 1978)
description: Haddonfield Cemetery, where Loomis and the groundskeeper find Judith Myers' headstone has been taken. The 1881 graveyard is still tucked behind the hedges.
address: 553 East Sierra Madre Boulevard, Sierra Madre, CA 91024

title: Lynda's House and the Hedge (Halloween 1978)
description: The Montrose Avenue block where Laurie spots Michael standing beside the hedge, looks away, and finds him gone. Locals have kept that hedge trimmed the same way for decades. Private residence.

title: Sepulveda Ambulatory Care Center (Halloween II 1981)
description: The exterior of Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where the ambulance rolls in with a sedated Laurie. Rob Zombie later shot the same complex as Smith's Grove.

title: Pasadena Community Hospital (Halloween II 1981)
description: Most of Haddonfield Memorial's interiors, including the reception desk, guard station, basement and generator rooms Michael stalks through all night.
address: 1845 North Fair Oaks Avenue, Pasadena, CA 91103

title: Alice's House (Halloween II 1981)
description: The Sierra Madre house where Michael claims Alice, his first kill after slipping away from the Myers place on Halloween night. Private residence, admire from the sidewalk.

title: Silver Shamrock Novelties Factory (Halloween III 1982)
description: Conal Cochran's mask factory in Santa Mira was this real milk bottling plant in tiny Loleta, California. The building still stands and now operates as a creamery.

title: Ridgemont Federal Sanitarium (Halloween 4 1988)
description: The Salt Lake City building that played Ridgemont, where a comatose Michael is loaded into the ambulance he wrecks minutes later.
address: 400 East Capitol Park Avenue, Salt Lake City, UT 84103

title: Jamie Lloyd's Foster Home (Halloween 4 1988)
description: The Carruthers house in Haddonfield, where Jamie is teased about her uncle and Rachel gets stuck babysitting on Halloween. Private residence, admire from the sidewalk.
address: 509 East 3rd Avenue, Salt Lake City, UT 84103

title: Sheriff Meeker's House (Halloween 4 1988)
description: The barricaded house where Michael comes in through the roof for the climax of Halloween 4. Private residence, admire from the sidewalk.

title: McGillis School (Halloween 4 1988)
description: Jamie's school, where classmates corner her in the schoolyard and taunt her about the boogeyman being her uncle.
address: 668 South 1300 East, Salt Lake City, UT 84102

title: Myers House (Halloween 5 1989)
description: This Salt Lake City house stood in for the derelict Myers place in Halloween 5, the setting for the whole final act with Jamie, Tina and Loomis. Private residence.

title: Myers House (Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers 1995)
description: Halloween 6 relocated the Myers house again, this time to a Sugar House bungalow occupied by the Strode family. Private residence, admire from the sidewalk.
address: 1926 Lincoln Street, Salt Lake City, UT 84105

title: Blankenship House (Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers 1995)
description: The house across the street where a grown Tommy Doyle rents the attic room and watches the Myers place through binoculars. Private residence.
address: 956 Ramona Avenue, Salt Lake City, UT 84105

title: Riverview Hospital (Halloween: Resurrection 2002)
description: The century-old Coquitlam psychiatric hospital that played Grace Andersen Sanitarium, where Laurie Strode is institutionalized and killed in the film's opening.

title: Myers House (Rob Zombie's Halloween 2007)
description: Zombie's version of the Myers house, the run-down home where young Michael's family falls apart and the killing starts. A few blocks from Carpenter's original. Private residence.

title: Country Girl Saloon (Rob Zombie's Halloween 2007)
description: The roadside Castaic bar that played the Rabbit in Red Lounge, where Deborah Myers works the stage while her son watches the family come apart.

title: Morgan County Courthouse (Rob Zombie's Halloween II 2009)
description: The Haddonfield Police Department in Rob Zombie's Halloween II is really this Georgia courthouse on the Madison town square.

title: Uncle Meat's Java Hole (Rob Zombie's Halloween II 2009)
description: The Madison, Georgia storefront used as the coffee house where a broken Laurie Strode works.

title: Magnolia Cemetery (Halloween 2018)
description: Haddonfield Cemetery in the 2018 film, shot in Charleston's historic Magnolia Cemetery. Fans caught the Sinclair headstone planted in frame as a deep-cut nod.

title: Military Magnet Academy (Halloween 2018)
description: Smith's Grove Sanitarium in the 2018 film, where the podcasters walk into the courtyard of chained-up patients and wave the mask at Michael.

title: Haddonfield Gas Station (Halloween 2018)
description: The Hanahan service station where Michael kills the mechanic and gets his mask back, one of the ugliest stops on his 2018 return to Haddonfield.

title: Julian's House (Halloween 2018)
description: The babysitting house where Laurie spots Michael in the second-floor window and opens fire on him from the street. Private residence, admire from the sidewalk.

title: Mick's Bar (Halloween Kills 2021)
description: The Wilmington bar, trading as the Rusty Nail, where Tommy Doyle whips the crowd into a mob and starts the Evil dies tonight chant.

title: Cape Fear Community College, McLeod Building (Halloween Kills 2021)
description: Haddonfield Memorial Hospital in Halloween Kills, where the mob corners the wrong man and chases him onto the roof.

title: Laurie Strode's House (Halloween Ends 2022)
description: Laurie and Allyson's Savannah house, the setting for the kitchen showdown that closes out the Blumhouse trilogy. Private residence, admire from the sidewalk.

title: WURG Radio Station (Halloween Ends 2022)
description: The Savannah building used as Haddonfield's WURG, where Corey catches up with the late-night DJ.

title: Canfield-Moreno Estate (Halloween H20 1998)
description: The 1920s silent-star mansion that played Hillcrest Academy, the boarding school where Laurie hides out as headmistress Keri Tate before she finally picks up the axe. Also Scream 3's mansion.

title: The Byers House (Stranger Things)
description: The real Hawkins house where Joyce tore down the walls and strung up the Christmas-light alphabet in Season 1. Private residence the owners now rent, so admire it from the road.

title: Starcourt Mall / Gwinnett Place Mall (Stranger Things)
description: The dying Georgia mall the production restored to 1985 glory as Starcourt for Season 3, complete with Scoops Ahoy and the Russian base underneath.

title: Hawkins Public Library (Stranger Things)
description: The Butts County Courthouse doubles as the Hawkins Public Library, where the kids dig through microfilm on Eleven and the Hawkins Lab. Roughly seven Hawkins locations sit within a walk.

title: Hawkins Radio Shack (Stranger Things)
description: The Jackson storefront dressed as Hawkins' Radio Shack, now a fan shop and the starting point for the town's Stranger Things walking tours.

title: The Creel House (Stranger Things)
description: Vecna's Victorian nightmare in Season 4 is the 1882 Claremont House in Rome, all mansard roof and bad intentions. Private residence, shoot it from the public sidewalk.

title: The Wheeler House (Stranger Things)
description: Mike and Nancy's split-level, where the basement D&D campaign kicked off the whole series. Private home on a quiet East Point street.
address: 2530 Piney Wood Ln, East Point, GA 30344

title: The Palace Arcade (Stranger Things)
description: Downtown Douglasville's storefront became the Palace Arcade, home of Dig Dug high scores and MADMAX taking the crown in Season 2.

title: Hawkins National Laboratory (Stranger Things)
description: The shuttered Georgia Mental Health Institute on Emory's Briarcliff campus played the Department of Energy lab in Seasons 1 and 2. That long brick facade is where Eleven escaped from.

title: Bisham Manor (The Haunting of Hill House)
description: The 1920s Tudor estate near West Point Lake that played every exterior of Hill House, including the red room windows. Now a private residence, view from the road.
address: 1901 Old Young's Mill Rd, LaGrange, GA 30240

title: The Whitlock Inn (The Haunting of Hill House)
description: Marietta's historic event house stood in for the Harris Funeral Home in Episode 6, the bottle episode built around Nell's wake.

title: Cecil Green Park House (The Haunting of Bly Manor)
description: The UBC mansion above the water that opens the series, hosting the rehearsal dinner where the storyteller starts the ghost story. Bly Manor itself was a studio build.
address: 6251 Cecil Green Park Rd, Vancouver, BC V6T 1Z1

title: Garry Point Park (Midnight Mass)
description: All of Crockett Island, St. Patrick's church included, was built as a set on this Richmond shoreline park. The buildings came down after the wrap, but the sea and the sunset are exactly as shot.

title: Cantacuzino Castle (Wednesday)
description: Nevermore Academy in the flesh: a 1911 Romanian castle in the Bucegi Mountains shot for the school's exterior and grounds. Open to the public, archery targets still on site.

title: Bucharest Botanical Garden (Wednesday)
description: The glasshouses where Nevermore students learn their carnivorous and deadly plants. Public and cheap to wander.

title: Torrance High School (Buffy the Vampire Slayer)
description: Sunnydale High, sitting right on top of the Hellmouth for three seasons. The same campus also played West Beverly in 90210, so it is the most haunted-looking school in television.

title: 1630 Revello Drive (Buffy the Vampire Slayer)
description: The Summers house, three blocks from Sunnydale High and the site of every kitchen conference and vampire-can't-cross-the-threshold moment. Private residence.

title: Buntzen Lake (Supernatural)
description: Lake Manitoc from Dead in the Water, the Season 1 episode with the drowned boy and the vengeful spirit in the water. Free public rec area with a swimming beach.

title: The Woodbury Shoppe, Senoia (The Walking Dead)
description: Downtown Senoia is the Governor's Woodbury from Season 3, and this shop on Main Street is the official store sitting inside the set. Cross the tracks and you are in Alexandria.

title: Nic and Norman's (The Walking Dead)
description: Norman Reedus and Greg Nicotero's own burger joint, opened on the Woodbury set street in Senoia and hung with Reedus's photography.

title: Jackson Street Bridge (The Walking Dead)
description: The Atlanta skyline view behind Rick Grimes as he rides toward the dead city in the Season 1 pilot. Public bridge, free, and the single most photographed shot in the show.
address: Jackson St NE at Freedom Pkwy, Atlanta, GA 30312

title: Twede's Cafe / The Double R Diner (Twin Peaks)
description: The Double R, home of damn fine coffee and cherry pie, has been serving both since 1990 and again in The Return. Still a working diner on North Bend's main drag.
address: 137 W North Bend Way, North Bend, WA 98045

title: Salish Lodge / The Great Northern (Twin Peaks)
description: Agent Cooper's home base, perched right on the lip of Snoqualmie Falls and seen in the opening credits of every episode. The exterior is essentially unchanged.

title: Twin Peaks Sheriff's Department (Twin Peaks)
description: The old Weyerhaeuser mill office played both the Packard Sawmill and the Sheriff's Department where Cooper, Truman and Lucy worked the Laura Palmer case. Now a rally driving school.

title: The Roadhouse, Fall City (Twin Peaks)
description: The exterior of the Roadhouse and Bang Bang Bar, where Julee Cruise sang and half the town's secrets got traded. Operating since 1916 and still pouring.
address: 4200 Preston Fall City Rd SE, Fall City, WA 98024

title: Baxter High (Chilling Adventures of Sabrina)
description: Greendale's Baxter High, where Sabrina fought the school board and the Weird Sisters, is a working Vancouver elementary school. Shoot the exterior outside school hours.
address: 592 E Pender St, Vancouver, BC V6A 1V3

title: Theo Putnam's House (Chilling Adventures of Sabrina)
description: The heritage Thomas Joseph Brown House in Surrey plays Theo's home in Greendale. Private property, photograph it from Colebrook Road.

title: Cranfield House (What We Do in the Shadows)
description: The 1902 Toronto mansion that played the Staten Island vampire residence in Season 1, exterior only. It now operates as a women's shelter, so do not knock and do not linger.

title: Jared S. Torrance House (What We Do in the Shadows)
description: The 1902 English Tudor manor in South Pasadena used for exterior establishing shots of the vampires' house. Private residence, sidewalk views only.
address: 929 Buena Vista St, South Pasadena, CA 91030

title: Gallier Hall (Interview with the Vampire 2022)
description: The Greek Revival landmark on St. Charles fronted the show's Mardi Gras parade sequence. Still the ceremonial heart of the city's parade route.
address: 545 St Charles Ave, New Orleans, LA 70130

title: Templeton Secondary School (Yellowjackets)
description: Wiskayok High in the later seasons, where the 1996 soccer team's story starts before the plane goes down. Working Vancouver high school, keep to the exterior.

title: Capitol Theatre (IT 2017)
description: The Derry movie house where Richie ditches his friends for the arcade, and where his grown-up flashbacks hit in Chapter Two. A working 1930 cinema, so buy a ticket and sit where the Losers sat.
address: 20 Queen St, Port Hope, ON L1A 3Z4

title: The Quality Meats Alley (IT 2017)
description: The alley beside Gould's Footwear is where Mike Hanlon's burning-hands vision hits and where Ben gets patched up after Henry Bowers carves him. The Derry mural was left in place.
address: 26 Walton St, Port Hope, ON L1A 1M9

title: Beverly's Apartment Door (IT 2017)
description: Queenies Bake Shop stood in for the street entrance to Beverly Marsh's apartment above the Derry pharmacy. Grab a pastry, then look up at the windows.
address: 16 Walton St, Port Hope, ON L1A 2Y8

title: Derry Public Library (IT 2017)
description: Port Hope's 1850s Town Hall played the Derry Public Library where Ben digs into the town's ugly history of disappearances. Still an active municipal building.
address: 56 Queen St, Port Hope, ON L1A 3Z9

title: Memorial Park Bandshell (IT Chapter Two 2019)
description: The park where the giant Paul Bunyan statue comes alive and goes after adult Richie. The 1946 bandshell is real; the lumberjack was built for the shoot and torn down after.
address: 44 Queen St, Port Hope, ON L1A 2Y7

title: The Derry Town House (IT Chapter Two 2019)
description: The Hotel Carlyle on John Street is the exterior of the Derry Town House, where the adult Losers check back in and Eddie meets the leper. You can book a room.
address: 86 John St, Port Hope, ON L1A 2Z2

title: The Neibolt Street House Lot (IT 2017)
description: The rotting house at 29 Neibolt Street was built from scratch on this vacant Oshawa corner, then torn down after filming. Nothing left but the lot where Pennywise's well house stood.
address: Eulalie Ave at James St, Oshawa, ON L1H 2C6

title: Elora Quarry (IT 2017)
description: The flooded limestone quarry where the Losers strip to their underwear and cliff-jump, right before Ben clocks Beverly. A real conservation area you can swim in during summer.
address: 319 Wellington County Rd 18, Elora, ON N0B 1S0

title: The Kissing Bridge (IT 2017)
description: Ontario's last covered bridge doubled as the Derry Kissing Bridge, where Ben carves the H for Beverly. Built in 1881 and still open to traffic.
address: Covered Bridge Dr, West Montrose, ON N0B 2V0

title: Elgin Theatre (IT Chapter Two 2019)
description: Toronto's 1913 Elgin Theatre is the comedy club where adult Richie Tozier bombs his stand-up set. A restored double-decker vaudeville house that runs public tours.

title: The Creed House (Pet Sematary 1989)
description: The yellow farmhouse with the wraparound porch where Louis Creed moves his family, right off the truck route that kills Church and Gage. Private residence, admire from the road.

title: Jud Crandall's House (Pet Sematary 1989)
description: Directly across Point Road from the Creeds, where Fred Gwynne's Jud sits on the porch and tells Louis about the burying ground beyond the deadfall. Private residence.

title: Mount Hope Cemetery (Pet Sematary 1989)
description: America's second-oldest garden cemetery, used for Gage's funeral and the night Louis digs his son back up. Stephen King himself shows up here as the minister.

title: St. James Church Cemetery (Pet Sematary 2019)
description: The churchyard in Hudson, Quebec that served as Ludlow's proper cemetery in the 2019 remake. The town square scenes were shot along this same stretch of rue Main.

title: Bates High School Gym (Carrie 1976)
description: The old Pier Avenue Junior High, now the Hermosa Beach Community Center, was Bates High and the prom gym where the pig blood drops and Carrie burns it all down.

title: Bates High Track and Fields (Carrie 1976)
description: Pali High's playing fields stood in for Bates High gym class, where Miss Collins drills the girls as punishment for the shower scene. Active public school, view from the street.

title: Farmer John's Pig Farm (Carrie 1976)
description: The Vernon slaughterhouse behind the famous painted pig murals is where Billy and Chris fill the bucket. The murals still wrap the block even though the plant has closed.

title: Genoa Bar and Saloon (Misery 1990)
description: Nevada's oldest saloon sits in the town that played Silver Creek, Colorado, visible as Annie drives in for supplies. Still pouring drinks since 1853.

title: Millennium Biltmore Hotel (Misery 1990)
description: The Biltmore's South Galleria plays the swanky New York restaurant where Paul Sheldon meets his agent Marcia. Walk right into the lobby, it is open to the public.
address: 506 S Grand Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90071

title: The Trenton House (Cujo 1983)
description: A facade was built around this Mendocino clifftop house to create the Trenton family home. Private residence, take it in from Crestwood Drive.

title: Gary Pervier's House (Cujo 1983)
description: The Sonoma Mountain place where the drunk neighbor gets torn apart by the rabid St. Bernard. Private property, view from Sonoma Mountain Road only.
address: 7301 Sonoma Mountain Rd, Glen Ellen, CA 95442

title: Arnie Cunningham's House (Christine 1983)
description: The South Pasadena home where Arnie parks a wrecked 1958 Plymouth Fury in the driveway and his parents lose it. Private residence, sidewalk views only.
address: 1037 Buena Vista St, South Pasadena, CA 91030

title: Rockbridge High School (Christine 1983)
description: Van Nuys High supplied the hallways and lockers where Buddy Repperton's crew torments Arnie. A working public school, admire the 1914 facade from Cedros Avenue.

title: Leigh Cabot's House (Christine 1983)
description: The Monrovia home where Arnie picks up Leigh for their date, shortly before the car decides she is competition. Private residence, admire from the sidewalk.

title: Hansen's Cafe (Children of the Corn 1984)
description: This Whiting corner is the exterior of the diner where the children of Gatlin slaughter every adult in town. Most of the film's chase scenes run through this intersection.

title: Gatlin Church Steps (Children of the Corn 1984)
description: A false church front was built next to the fire station on Tipton Street in Salix for Isaac's congregation. The steps where the kids gather are still recognizable.

title: The Marsten House (Salem's Lot 1979)
description: An ordinary Ferndale home got a nightmare facade bolted onto it to become the Marsten House looming over Tobe Hooper's miniseries. The fake front came off after filming.

title: Barlow and Straker Antiques (Salem's Lot 1979)
description: The Ferndale storefront that became the antique shop run by James Mason's Straker, the vampire's very polite human front man.

title: Ben Mears' Boarding House (Salem's Lot 1979)
description: Eva Miller's boarding house, where writer Ben Mears rents a room while the town quietly turns. Private residence on Ferndale's Ocean Avenue.

title: Plaza Theatre (Doctor Sleep 2019)
description: Atlanta's oldest operating cinema appears as Dan Torrance moves through his new town. Still running horror programming, which feels about right.
address: 1049 Ponce De Leon Ave NE, Atlanta, GA 30306

title: Abra Stone's House (Doctor Sleep 2019)
description: The Ansley Park stone house where young Abra writes MURDER on her bedroom wall and starts pulling the True Knot toward her. Private residence.
address: 1692 Friar Tuck Rd NE, Atlanta, GA 30309

title: Frazier Town Square (Doctor Sleep 2019)
description: Covington's square plays Frazier, New Hampshire, where Dan steps off the bus and tries to get sober. The mountains behind it are CGI.

title: Johnny Smith's House (The Dead Zone 1983)
description: The Niagara-on-the-Lake house Christopher Walken's Johnny Smith comes home to after five years in a coma, in Cronenberg's adaptation. Private residence.

title: Rollie's Bar and Grill (Thinner 1996)
description: Interior scenes were shot inside this Main Street bar in Belfast, Maine, one of several downtown storefronts the crew took over. Still a working bar and grill.

title: The Dolphin Hotel (1408, 2007)
description: Midtown's Roosevelt Hotel provided the exterior of the Dolphin, the hotel John Cusack talks his way into so he can spend one night in room 1408.

title: The Armitage House (Get Out 2017)
description: The Armitage family estate where Chris meets the parents and finds the Sunken Place. A private residence on six acres, admire it from the road and do not turn into the drive.

title: Barton Academy (Get Out 2017)
description: The hypnosis basement and the Armitage's underground operating room were shot inside Alabama's oldest public school building. The Gothic Revival landmark is now a working magnet school.

title: Ryan Avenue, Park Place (Get Out 2017)
description: The opening abduction, where Andre gets snatched off a quiet suburban street while Run Rabbit Run plays. Still the same eerie, empty sidewalk.
address: Ryan Avenue at De Leon Avenue, Mobile, AL 36607

title: The Wilson Vacation House (Us 2019)
description: The Wilsons' Santa Cruz summer house, where the Tethered show up in the driveway holding hands, is actually in the Kinneloa Mesa hills above Pasadena. Private and gated, a drive-by at best.

title: The Tyler House (Us 2019)
description: Josh and Kitty Tyler's glass-walled place, site of the Good Vibrations massacre and Ophelia refusing to call the police. Private home, keep to the street.

title: 207 Riverside Avenue (Us 2019)
description: The corner where young Adelaide passes the Jeremiah 11:11 sign man being loaded onto a stretcher, one block off the boardwalk. The whole 11:11 motif starts right here.

title: East Cliff Drive, Seabright (Us 2019)
description: The stretch near Seabright Beach where Pluto walks backward into the burning car as Jason mirrors his steps. Public street with a great ocean view and no fire, thankfully.
address: East Cliff Drive near Seabright State Beach, Santa Cruz, CA 95062

title: Jupiter's Claim at Universal Studios (Nope 2022)
description: Ricky Park's western theme park was built for the shoot, then dismantled and rebuilt permanently at Universal Studios Hollywood. You can walk the actual Star Lasso grandstand on the studio tour.
address: 100 Universal City Plaza, Universal City, CA 91608

title: Firestone Ranch, Agua Dulce (Nope 2022)
description: The Haywood Hollywood Horses ranch, where OJ watches the cloud that never moves. The house was a set and came down after the shoot, but the ridgeline is unmistakable.

title: The Old Fry's Electronics, Burbank (Nope 2022)
description: The big-box store where Angel sells OJ and Em the surveillance cameras that will maybe catch Jean Jacket on film. Closed since 2021, but the building still stands.

title: The Graham House (Hereditary 2018)
description: Annie's dollhouse-like home, the treehouse, the attic and that final ceiling shot. Inside the gated Colony community and a private residence, not visible from the gate.
address: 7 White Pine Canyon Road, Park City, UT 84060

title: Richardson Flat Road (Hereditary 2018)
description: The dark stretch of road outside Park City where Peter drives home and Charlie leans out the window. The telephone pole was a prop built for the film and is long gone.
address: Richardson Flat Road, Park City, UT 84060

title: Larkin Sunset Gardens (Hereditary 2018)
description: Charlie's funeral, with the Wasatch peaks behind the mourners, was filmed at this Sandy, Utah memorial park. An active cemetery, so visit quietly.

title: Joan's Apartment Building (Hereditary 2018)
description: The Maryland Condominium on South Temple played Joan's building, where Annie gets talked into the seance that ruins everything.
address: 839 East South Temple Street, Salt Lake City, UT 84102

title: Farkashegy Airfield, Budakeszi (Midsommar 2019)
description: Harga was built from nothing in a field beside this small Hungarian glider airfield outside Budapest, sun temple and yellow pyramid and all. Not one frame was shot in Sweden.

title: Dani's Family Home (Midsommar 2019)
description: The Draper, Utah house used for the opening tragedy, the phone calls, the carbon monoxide, the worst night of Dani's life. Private residence.

title: Kiosk, Algonquin Provincial Park (The Witch 2015)
description: Robert Eggers shot in the deep bush at Kiosk, outside Mattawa, because he could not find woods bleak enough anywhere else. Exactly the forest that swallows Samuel.
address: Kiosk, Algonquin Provincial Park, Ontario P0H 1L0

title: Cape Forchu Lightstation (The Lighthouse 2019)
description: Eggers built a 70-foot working lighthouse tower on this windswept Nova Scotia cape for Dafoe and Pattinson to lose their minds in. The real light and its brutal weather are open to visitors.

title: Max and Dani's House (Hocus Pocus 1993)
description: The seaside house where Max sulks about moving to Salem and Dani demands to go trick or treating. A private residence and a pilgrimage site every October, photograph from the street.

title: Ropes Mansion (Hocus Pocus 1993)
description: Allison's house, where Max talks his way into the Halloween party. Run by the Peabody Essex Museum and its garden out back is free and open to the public.

title: Old Town Hall, Derby Square (Hocus Pocus 1993)
description: The town hall where Winifred Sanderson takes the stage and puts a spell on all of Salem's parents. The 1816 building still stands and is open to the public.

title: Salem Common (Hocus Pocus 1993)
description: The green where Max walks Allison home after school and tries out his terrible flirting. Nine acres of public park, and ground zero for Salem in October.
address: Salem Common, Washington Square, Salem, MA 01970

title: Old Burial Hill (Hocus Pocus 1993)
description: The hilltop graveyard where Jay and Ice shake Max down for his sneakers, filmed in Marblehead rather than Salem. Colonial headstones from the 1600s with a harbor view.
address: Orne Street at Pond Street, Marblehead, MA 01945

title: Pioneer Village (Hocus Pocus 1993)
description: The 1693 prologue, Thackery Binx's cottage and the Sandersons' hanging were shot in America's first living history museum.

title: Burkittsville Union Cemetery (The Blair Witch Project 1999)
description: The hillside graveyard where Heather delivers her opening piece to camera before the trio heads into the woods. Still a working cemetery in a town of about 150 people.
address: Main Street at Burkittsville Road, Burkittsville, MD 21718

title: Seneca Creek State Park (The Blair Witch Project 1999)
description: The Black Hills Forest is really Seneca Creek State Park, where the cast wandered with a map and a camera for eight days. Over 50 miles of trails, and people still stack rocks out there.

title: Mommer's Diner Building (The Blair Witch Project 1999)
description: The diner where the filmmakers interview locals about the Blair Witch legend, then the old Silver Rail Diner in Brunswick. The building still carries the Mommer's name.

title: Cole Sear's House (The Sixth Sense 1999)
description: The narrow rowhouse where Cole builds his church tent and finally tells his mother about the people he sees. Private home on a tiny Philadelphia side street.

title: Malcolm Crowe's House (The Sixth Sense 1999)
description: The Delancey Place townhouse where Bruce Willis sits at the anniversary dinner his wife does not notice, and where the whole thing clicks at the end. Private residence.

title: St. Augustine Church (The Sixth Sense 1999)
description: The Old City church where Malcolm first finds Cole hiding in a pew surrounded by toy soldiers. Philadelphia's oldest Augustinian parish, still open for visitors.

title: Peirce College (The Sixth Sense 1999)
description: St Anthony's Academy, where Cole tells his teacher the school used to be a courthouse and people were hanged out front.

title: Delaware Valley University Farm (Signs 2002)
description: The Hess farmhouse and its crop circles were built on 40 acres of this agricultural college's farmland. The house was a set and came down after the shoot, but the cornfields are real.

title: Newtown Book and Record Exchange (Signs 2002)
description: The bookstore where Morgan reads up on aliens while Graham argues with the old shopkeeper. Still a working used book and record shop.

title: Cossart Road, Chadds Ford (The Village 2004)
description: Covington was built from scratch in two open fields off Cossart Road. Every building was torn down a month before release and the land restored, so what you get is the countryside itself.

title: Philadelphia Zoo (Split 2016)
description: Kevin's underground lair, where Casey and the girls are held and The Beast finally arrives, was filmed in the tunnels beneath America's first zoo.

title: 30th Street Station (Split 2016 / Glass 2019)
description: The grand concourse where Glass closes out, as the world finally sees footage of what these three men could do. A working Amtrak station and one of the great American train halls.

title: King of Prussia Mall (Split 2016)
description: The mall where Split opens, Casey gets the pity invite, and the girls walk out to the car that is not driven by anyone's dad. Largest shopping mall on the East Coast.
address: 160 North Gulph Road, King of Prussia, PA 19406

title: Casey Becker's House (Scream 1996)
description: The white farmhouse where Drew Barrymore answers the phone, flunks the horror trivia quiz and ends up hanging from a tree. Private residence, admire from the roadside.
address: 7420 Sonoma Mountain Road, Glen Ellen, CA 95442

title: Stu Macher's House (Scream 1996)
description: The Spring Hill dairy ranch house outside Tomales that hosted the party from hell and the original Ghostface unmasking. Private property that occasionally opens for Scream events, never just turn up.

title: Woodsboro High School (Scream 1996)
description: The Sonoma Community Center played Woodsboro High after Santa Rosa High's board read the script and pulled out. Where Sidney gets suspended and Principal Himbry meets the sharp end.

title: Bradley Video Store (Scream 1996)
description: Randy Meeks' video store, where he lays down the rules of surviving a horror movie. The video shop is long gone and the building now houses a restaurant.

title: Tatum Riley's House (Scream 1996)
description: The McDonald Avenue home where Tatum lives with big brother Dewey, and where Sidney hides out after the first attack. Private residence, admire from the sidewalk.

title: Sidney Prescott's House (Scream 1996)
description: Sidney's home on Calistoga Road, site of the closet attack and the hello-Sidney phone call that starts it all. Behind a locked gate on private land.

title: Woodsboro Town Square (Scream 1996)
description: Healdsburg's plaza doubled for downtown Woodsboro, where the news vans camp out and the town reels after the murders. Fully public and barely changed since 1996.
address: Matheson Street at Center Street, Healdsburg, CA 95448

title: Woodsboro Police Station (Scream 1996)
description: The Healdsburg police station stood in for the Woodsboro PD where Billy is hauled in after Casey's murder. Working police building, be respectful outside.

title: Pacific Market (Scream 1996)
description: The grocery store where Sidney and Tatum shop for the party while Woodsboro is under curfew. Still a working neighborhood market.
address: 1465 Town and Country Drive, Santa Rosa, CA 95404

title: Windsor College (Scream 2 1997)
description: Agnes Scott College outside Atlanta played Windsor College, home of Sidney's dorm, sorority row and the entire second-act body count. A working campus you can walk.

title: Vista Theatre (Scream 2 1997)
description: The auditorium for the Stab premiere opening, where the audience cheers while a real murder happens in the aisle. Still an operating single-screen movie palace.

title: Harper House (Scream 3 2000)
description: Cotton Weary's West Hollywood apartment building, where Scream 3 opens with Ghostface killing him and his girlfriend. The 1929 Harper House is a private residence.
address: 1336 North Harper Avenue, West Hollywood, CA 90046

title: CBS Studio Center (Scream 3 2000)
description: Stood in for Sunrise Studios, where Stab 3 is shooting and Ghostface stalks the fake Woodsboro backlot sets. A working studio lot, exterior viewing only.

title: Canfield-Moreno Estate (Scream 3 2000)
description: The Paramour Estate in Silver Lake is producer John Milton's mansion, home of the climactic reveal and the final Ghostface showdown. Private event estate.

title: Jill Roberts' House (Scream 4 2011)
description: Sidney's cousin Jill lives here in Ann Arbor's Burns Park, where Sidney comes home to a new generation of Woodsboro victims. Private residence.

title: Olivia Morris' House (Scream 4 2011)
description: The house next door to Jill's, where Ghostface guts Olivia while Sidney and Jill watch helplessly from the window. Private residence, sidewalk only.

title: Woodsboro Bookstore (Scream 4 2011)
description: The Next Chapter Bookstore in downtown Northville is where Sidney signs copies of Out of Darkness and Ghostface starts calling again. Public storefront.

title: Woodsboro High School (Scream 4 2011)
description: Woodworth Middle School in Dearborn served as Woodsboro High, including the Cinema Club scenes and the parking lot attack. Active school, view from the street.

title: Stab-a-thon Barn (Scream 4 2011)
description: The rural barn where Charlie Walker throws the Stab-a-thon marathon that turns into a bloodbath. Private farmland outside Saline.

title: Kirby Reed's House (Scream 4 2011)
description: The Northville house that hosts the Stab-a-thon after-party and the brutal final act, including Kirby's horror-trivia standoff at the front door. Private residence.

title: Tara Carpenter's House (Scream 2022)
description: The 1939 Forest Hills home where Ghostface attacks Tara in the opening sequence and kicks off the requel. Private residence in a quiet Wilmington neighborhood.

title: Woodsboro High School (Scream 2022)
description: Williston Middle School in Wilmington became the new Woodsboro High, backdrop for the hallway scenes and Vince's introduction. Working school, exterior viewing only.

title: Meeks-Martin House (Scream 2022)
description: Chad and Mindy's family home, where the Meeks-Martin twins get tangled in the new rules of a requel. Private residence built in 1954.
address: 1823 South Live Oak Parkway, Wilmington, NC 28403

title: Judy and Wes Hicks' House (Scream 2022)
description: The 1903 Princess Place home where Sheriff Judy Hicks and her son Wes both meet Ghostface in one of the film's nastiest sequences. Private residence.

title: Woodsboro Police Station (Scream 2022)
description: The ILA Union Building played the Woodsboro PD, and the street outside is where Vince is killed. The same block appears in Halloween Kills.

title: Cardinal Lanes Bowling (Scream 2022)
description: Richie and Sam's bowling alley scene was shot at this real Wilmington alley on Shipyard Boulevard. Open to the public, so you can actually bowl a frame here.

title: Sam and Tara's Apartment (Scream VI 2023)
description: Montreal doubled for New York throughout Scream VI, and this Rue Milton building is the exterior of the sisters' apartment. Private residential building.

title: Blackmore University (Scream VI 2023)
description: McGill University's downtown campus stood in for Blackmore University, where the Core Four are students when Ghostface follows them to the city. Public campus grounds.
address: 845 Rue Sherbrooke Ouest, Montreal, QC H3A 0G4

title: Le National / The Shrine (Scream VI 2023)
description: The Montreal venue Le National played The Shrine, the Ghostface shrine packed with props from every previous killing. A working concert hall you can buy tickets to.
address: 1220 Rue Sainte-Catherine Est, Montreal, QC H2L 2H7

title: Thomas W. Phillips Residence (The People Under the Stairs 1991)
description: The 1905 West Adams mansion Wes Craven used as the Robeson house, the nightmare home with the cellar full of captives. A Historic-Cultural Monument and a private residence.
address: 2215 South Harvard Boulevard, Los Angeles, CA 90018

title: Desert Gas Station Site (The Hills Have Eyes 1977)
description: The Palmdale Road stretch in Phelan where Fred's gas station sat, the last stop before the Carter family drives into the hills. The structure is long gone, the desert road is not.

title: Carter Family Breakdown Site (The Hills Have Eyes 1977)
description: The Apple Valley spot where the Carters crash their station wagon and trailer, stranding them in cannibal country. Open high desert off Kensington Street.
